note: Curated snapshot of public figures. The Bank of Finland API needs a subscription key, so these are copied from the cited pages. Update by hand and bump retrievedAt.

loanCap.comment: FIN-FSA: a housing loan may be at most 90% of the collateral value (95% for first-home loans). FIN-FSA decided on 30 June 2026 to raise the cap to 95% for all borrowers; the article does not state an effective date, so this app uses the 90% general cap to stay cautious.

stress.comment: FIN-FSA consumer guidance: when assessing ability to service a loan, use an interest rate of at least 6%, even when rates are low.

rates.label: Bank of Finland, average interest rate on new housing loans, May 2026

assumptions.comment: Loan term is an assumption for the payment estimate; the dataset does not contain terms.
